Apple Announces Special Event 'Homecoming' Next Tuesday, October 13

Apple to Unveil New Home Products on October 13, Teased by Greg Joswiak

Apple will unveil new hardware products on Tuesday (October 13), with Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak releasing a teaser video first. Below is the video uploaded by Joswiak.

Apple is expected to launch several new Home products at the event, including:

We may also see the previously leaked LG home accessories officially unveiled next week, which are reportedly products developed by Apple in collaboration with LG.

Along with announcing the date, Joswiak also sent invitations to the media to attend a special "Apple Experience" event held at 9:00 AM (Eastern Time) at Tribeca in New York.

Below is the invitation shown by Marques Brownlee:

JP's comment received the most likes.

Three products. I'm guessing it's the Apple Car, in three colors: Space Gray, White, and another slightly different shade of White.

Earlier this year, when Apple launched the MacBook Neo, it also held a similar "Apple Experience" event for the media. That product launch took place after several days of consecutive press releases.

However, the prevailing expectation is that all of Apple's new Home products will make their debut on the same day.

It is currently unclear whether Apple will simultaneously upload complete product introduction videos at 9:00 AM (Eastern Time) that day. We will continue to keep you updated on the latest news.

What new products are you most looking forward to seeing Apple launch on October 13? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
